content: वितर्कः .²1 Argument, reasoning, inference. .²2 Guess, conjecture, supposition, belief; शिरीषपुष्पाधिकसौकुमार्यौ बाहू तदीयाविति मे वितर्कः <ls>Ku. 1. 41</ls>. .²3 Fancy, thought; रागग्राहवती वितर्कविहगा <ls>Bh. 3. 45</ls>. .²4 Doubt; नुनोद तस्य स्थलपद्मिनीगतं वितर्कम् <ls>Ki. 4. 5</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">13. 2</ls>. .²5 Deliberation, discussion. .²6 A teacher in divine knowledge. .²7 False or adverse conjecture; वितर्कं निश्चयाज्जयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 274. 11</ls>. .²8 Purpose, intention.
